value.rationale: Rule 110 has longstanding period-seven stationary glider examples. The exact maximal forbidden circumference 30, thirteen exceptional shorter supported lengths, global all-ring existence theorem and exact 63-state matrix orbit census close a motivated natural gap between samples and classification. Disappearance of all primitive temporal-six cycles sharpens the interpretation as a temporal resonance boundary. This is not a mere renamed result or an arbitrary local slice.
